model.name: standard one-guard-moves eternal domination
model.attack_rule: Only an unoccupied vertex is attacked.
model.move_rule: Exactly one guard moves along one graph edge to the attacked vertex.
model.closure_rule: The successor configuration belongs to the same eternal family and dominates the graph.

candidate_theorem.hypotheses: gamma(G)=alpha(G)=gamma_infinity(G)=3; S={a,b,c} is an independent member of an eternal family F; H=complement(G).
candidate_theorem.conclusion: H has no induced path x0-x1-x2-x3 whose exact static dominating-swap lists at S are {a}, {a,c}, {b,c}, {b}.
candidate_theorem.proof_type: Human reduction to a complete finite local kernel over all five undecided core adjacencies.
accepted_dependencies: C-121 static-to-family rigidity and arbitrary-state restoration

scope_exclusions: The exact family-list mixed P4 is not excluded when one or more static lists are larger.
Arbitrary longer two-unit chains and one-unit lollipops are not excluded.
The full-response-list branch is not excluded.
The complete k=3 case is not proved.
The universal gamma-theta conjecture is not resolved.

FDzro.purpose: Shows that an exact family-list mixed P4 can coexist with larger static lists and gamma=2.

HCOceRy.purpose: Shows that two adjacent pure same-color singleton vertices do not by themselves force an infinite cascade.

guardrail: The contradiction uses the complete mixed-P4 incidence and exact static-list system. Singleton purity plus same-color clique structure alone is compatible with equality.
